baseline_census.fingerprint_algorithm: Site SHA-256 input is UTF-8 repo-relative path, NUL, decimal line, NUL, site kind, NUL, stripped matched source. Per-file site-set SHA-256 input is compact sorted-key JSON of ordered objects containing kind, line, and normalized_source. Aggregate SHA-256 input is compact sorted-key JSON of path and site_set_sha256 objects ordered by path. Line positions are intentional so new or moved sites change the baseline.
baseline_census.pattern_note: The accepted 188-catch census includes seven broad catches with trailing noqa comments. Operational patterns preserve the accepted baseline; displayed document patterns remain separately recorded.
